name: Synn
message: 「Good morning, Nanaka. Full of energy today, as usual.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's all this? Wire and fireworks? Collecting junk again, are we?」

name: Synn
message: 「If it can be used, it's not junk.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even so, fireworks in this season? Talk about out of place. Aren't they damp anyway?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... testing it here would be a waste, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, this really isn't helping me tidy up.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The secret to organizing is throwing stuff away! Anyway, I'm borrowing the kitchen!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll wash the dishes, so go get ready for school.」
